offers_services.reason: Services such as Crane Nuclear valve maintenance are minor next to the engineered products it manufactures.

big_ticket.reason: Valves, pumps, sensors and aerospace components are individually modest, frequently reordered components, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured proprietary products like valves, pumps and sensors, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large chemical, energy, nuclear and utility operators, aerospace OEMs, airlines and defense agencies.
